label: Trahanas
note: Greek trahanas has only cracked wheat or a couscous-like paste and fermented milk; Turkish tarhana adds yoghurt and vegetables, and Armenian tarkhana adds eggs.

about.text: A dried food of cracked wheat or a couscous-like paste mixed with fermented milk, dried into coarse crumbs and made into a thick soup. It is acidic and dry, so it keeps long. In Cyprus it is a national speciality, often served with halloumi.
